summary: Baskin-Robbins is an American ice cream and cake specialty shop chain headquartered in Canton, Massachusetts. Founded in 1945 by Burt Baskin and Irv Robbins in Glendale, California, it claims to be the world's largest chain of ice cream specialty stores. The note cites about 7,500 locations as of December 28, 2013, and sales in nearly 50 countries.
